title: Geosql: A Claude/Codex skill for geospatial data
summary: Geosql is a specialized skill/plugin designed to enable AI assistants like Claude and Codex to interact with and query geospatial data, likely through SQL-like syntax for geographic information systems.
problem_solved: Enables AI assistants to understand and process geospatial/spatial data queries that they traditionally struggle with.
why_valuable: Bridges the gap between AI language models and geographic data processing, making location-based analysis accessible through natural language.
